from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperInfo(BaseModel):
    """A single paper parsed from the document collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this specific paper")
    bibliography_entries: list[str] = Field(description="All bibliographic reference strings found in the bibliography section of this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperInfo]
